overview.about: LIV Golf Singapore is played at Sentosa Golf Club, a resort-island venue that also stages the LPGA and, historically, the Singapore Open. Its Serapong course offers waterfront holes and a lush tropical backdrop beside the city-state's skyline.
overview.nextEvent: The next LIV Golf Singapore runs over 54 holes at Sentosa, individual and team competitions together. Heat, humidity and the occasional tropical downpour add to the challenge on the island layout.
